procedure_column: Neuman+2025 | WashU St. Louis | WDS Mapping (JEOL JXA-8200)

Procedure Name.cell: EPMA-WDS quantitative compositional mapping, Apollo 17 core 73001 continuous thin sections (Washington University in St. Louis)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA-WDS quantitative compositional mapping, Apollo 17 core 73001 continuous thin sections (Washington University in St. Louis)

Procedure Author.cell: N (no individual operator named for the EPMA work)

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Neuman et al. 2025, J. Geophys. Res. Planets 130, e2024JE008556; doi:10.1029/2024JE008556 (section 2.6)
Procedure Reference(s).value: Neuman et al. 2025, J. Geophys. Res. Planets 130, e2024JE008556; doi:10.1029/2024JE008556 (section 2.6)

Coupled Technique(s).cell: BSE mosaic imaging (same JEOL JXA-8200); QEMSCAN (FEI QUANTA 650 FEG-SEM, Univ. Manchester); optical microscopy (Keyence VHX 7000, NASA JSC); micro-XCT (custom NSI instrument, UTCT)
Coupled Technique(s).value: BSE mosaic imaging (same JEOL JXA-8200); QEMSCAN (FEI QUANTA 650 FEG-SEM, Univ. Manchester); optical microscopy (Keyence VHX 7000, NASA JSC); micro-XCT (custom NSI instrument, UTCT)

Coupling Description.cell: Single-element and RGB composite X-ray maps are compared with BSE and optical image mosaics (reflected light, plane polarized, crossed polars) to discriminate crystalline from glassy phases; an Al-Mg-Fe RGB composite X-ray map is used to discriminate feldspathic (red) from ferromagnesian (green and blue) phases
Coupling Description.value: Single-element and RGB composite X-ray maps are compared with BSE and optical image mosaics (reflected light, plane polarized, crossed polars) to discriminate crystalline from glassy phases; an Al-Mg-Fe RGB composite X-ray map is used to discriminate feldspathic (red) from ferromagnesian (green and blue) phases

Target Material.cell: lunar regolith (Apollo 17 double drive tube, lower section 73001) — as continuous thin sections

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Core extruded and dissected in 0.5 cm depth intervals; the remaining material impregnated with epoxy to create a continuous thin section set of the entire core; sections are 50 x 25 mm. Carbon coating N
Sample Preparation Method.value: Core extruded and dissected in 0.5 cm depth intervals; the remaining material impregnated with epoxy to create a continuous thin section set of the entire core; sections are 50 x 25 mm. Carbon coating N

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Analysis point - each map pixel is a fully quantitative analysis (1,024 x 1,024 per stage map; five stage maps per thin section; 20 x 10^6 analyses across all slides)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Analysis point - each map pixel is a fully quantitative analysis (1,024 x 1,024 per stage map; five stage maps per thin section; 20 x 10^6 analyses across all slides)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N - continuous thin sections of the whole core; five stage maps per section, no selection rule stated
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: N - continuous thin sections of the whole core; five stage maps per section, no selection rule stated

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: BSE mosaic: approximately 325 backscattered-electron images collected with the JEOL guide-net mapping software at 15 kV, 2 nA probe current and 70x magnification, stitched with the ImageJ Fiji grid-collection stitching plug-in (Donovan et al., 2021) into a 20k x 5k pixel mosaic at ~1.5 um pixel resolution
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: BSE mosaic: approximately 325 backscattered-electron images collected with the JEOL guide-net mapping software at 15 kV, 2 nA probe current and 70x magnification, stitched with the ImageJ Fiji grid-collection stitching plug-in (Donovan et al., 2021) into a 20k x 5k pixel mosaic at ~1.5 um pixel resolution

Acquisition Software.cell: JEOL guide-net mapping software (BSE mosaic); N for the WDS stage maps
Acquisition Software.value: JEOL guide-net mapping software (BSE mosaic); N for the WDS stage maps

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Probe Software CalcImage and Probe for EPMA (full Phi(rho-z) correction at each pixel); MATLAB routines generating 32-bit floating point .tiff quantitative maps; Fiji and MATLAB for stitching; ENVI input image stacks
Data Processing Software(s).value: Probe Software CalcImage and Probe for EPMA (full Phi(rho-z) correction at each pixel); MATLAB routines generating 32-bit floating point .tiff quantitative maps; Fiji and MATLAB for stitching; ENVI input image stacks

WDS Spectrometer Configuration.cell: Fixed wavelength-dispersive spectrometers; count not stated (five elements collected per pass)
WDS Spectrometer Configuration.value: Fixed wavelength-dispersive spectrometers; count not stated (five elements collected per pass)

Analytical Mode.cell: WDS Mapping — 'five EPMA stage maps were acquired using fixed wavelength-dispersive spectrometers (WDS)'

Beam Mode.cell: N/A — mapping-only procedure; map conditions under Mapping Beam Mode

Beam Current.cell: N/A — mapping-only procedure; map current under Mapping Beam Current; the 2 nA BSE mosaic is recorded under Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening

Beam Diameter.cell: N/A — mapping-only procedure; map beam under Mapping Beam Diameter

Beam Raster Dimensions.cell: N/A — stage scan, not beam scan

Mapping Beam Mode.cell: Fixed 10 µm beam (stated 'a fixed 10 um electron beam')
Mapping Beam Mode.value: Fixed 10 µm beam (stated 'a fixed 10 um electron beam')

Target Species.cell: Mg, Al, Fe, Ca, Ti, Na, Si, Mn, K, Cr (ten elements, collected in two passes)

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: Mg, Al, Fe, Ca, Ti, Na, Si, Mn, K, Cr — 'Two passes were used to collect X-ray intensities for Mg, Al, Fe, Ca, and Ti in pass 1, and Na, Si, Mn, K, and Cr in pass 2' (p.6)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: element wt% maps; oxide wt% maps; cation stoichiometry; mineral endmember maps — 32-bit floating point .tiff

WDS Spectrometer Channel.cell: N — spectrometer-to-element assignments are not stated

Sequence.cell: Mg, Al, Fe, Ca, Ti: pass 1; Na, Si, Mn, K, Cr: pass 2 — 'Two passes were used to collect X-ray intensities for Mg, Al, Fe, Ca, and Ti in pass 1, and Na, Si, Mn, K, and Cr in pass 2'

Peak Counting Time.cell: N/A — mapping-only procedure; the 25 msec per-pixel dwell is under Dwell Time per Pixel

Background Counting Time.cell: N/A — MAN background calibration; no off-peak counting

Background Position(s).cell: N/A — MAN background calibration; no off-peak positions

Dwell Time per Pixel.cell: all: 25 msec — the MAN background correction 'allows all map collection time to be dedicated to on-peak X-ray measurement'

Step Size / Pixel Size.cell: 9.5 um (stage maps); ~1.5 um per pixel (BSE mosaic)
Step Size / Pixel Size.value: 9.5 um (stage maps); ~1.5 um per pixel (BSE mosaic)

Matrix Correction Method.cell: Full Phi(rho-z) correction applied at each pixel, of the form C = k x ZAF, where ZAF is the compositionally dependent correction for atomic number, X-ray absorption and characteristic fluorescence in both sample and standard
Matrix Correction Method.value: Full Phi(rho-z) correction applied at each pixel, of the form C = k x ZAF, where ZAF is the compositionally dependent correction for atomic number, X-ray absorption and characteristic fluorescence in both sample and standard

X-ray Background Correction Method.cell: all: Mean Atomic Number (MAN) — MAN background calibration, using 'EPMA standards having a range of average atomic number Z'

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: all: k-ratio against the calibration standard — k = (P-B)smp / (P-B)std, the background-corrected relative peak X-ray intensity at each pixel compared to the calibration standard

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — 'EPMA standards having a range of average atomic number Z' are used for the MAN background calibration; individual standards not named

Detection Limit.cell: all: 0.1–0.2 element wt% — 'for all elements in this map set'

Detection Limit Method.cell: N — attributed to the MAN background correction dedicating all map collection time to on-peak measurement, 'which improves precision and detection limits'

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Multi-pass WDS mapping: two passes per stage map, five elements each; 18 hr per map; 20 x 10^6 fully quantitative analyses across all slides. Recorded in the acquisition-pass proposal (2026-09-08) as the evidence that EPMA partitions the target-species domain across passes.
Additional Notes.value: Multi-pass WDS mapping: two passes per stage map, five elements each; 18 hr per map; 20 x 10^6 fully quantitative analyses across all slides. Recorded in the acquisition-pass proposal (2026-09-08) as the evidence that EPMA partitions the target-species domain across passes.
